description: Limits for an L3 request: how many attempts, how large the knowledge brief and the handoff summary may be. verify: the end checks (main_stop: block once when the request is open and not waiting; subagent_stop: block, log or off; task_file_reminder: a task with a TASK.md whose files were written in a prompt while TASK.md was not, is asked once at Stop to update it). review: a task with [review]=n may use n + extra_checks checks before a person must allow more; max_n caps the n a prompt can ask for. snapshots: how long the copies made at the gates are kept, and the largest file that is copied.
